videos.script: Lessons 5 and 7 ran Whisper inside your own programs. This lesson sends audio to Whisper as a service, through OpenAI's API. {{title}} One file in, text out. The interesting part is the shape you ask for. Plain text, timed segments, or a caption file ready for a video. {{formats}} There is a second endpoint that translates. Portuguese speech in, English text out. {{translate}} There is a field called prompt, which helps with names, and this course cannot show it working. You will see why. {{prompt}} And there is a limit of twenty-five megabytes per file. Half an hour of call blows through it. You will cut the call at its silences and put the times back together. {{limit}} Here a small server on your own computer answers in place of OpenAI. Behind it is the real Whisper, smaller than OpenAI's. {{end}}
